patch_description: Remove the underperforming ZZZ interaction, schedule the same complete interaction graph into disjoint commuting CZ matchings to reduce effective depth, and add a capacity-controlled post-entanglement RY readout layer. The output rotations provide useful basis adaptation seen in the strongest prior candidate, while symmetry-based parameter sharing limits the increase to six new parameters per repeated block and should improve validation accuracy without the heavy cost of a full second RY/RZ layer.
